heading: Study with Confidence.
description: Turn your creative, technical, or academic skills into dependable pocket money and tuition support while building a verified professional portfolio before graduation.
imageAlt: Smiling African university student with backpack and laptop earning independently

items.heading: Earn Real Income Without Waiting for Graduation
items.description: You shouldn't have to wait until you have a degree in hand before you start earning. Turn your design, writing, research, social media, coding, or academic skills into steady income to support your living costs, tuition, and tech tools.

items.heading: Your Studies Always Come First
items.description: Lectures, tests, and exam weeks are non-negotiable. With TASA, you choose when you're available, set your own turnaround times, and manage your project volume so your academics never suffer.

items.heading: Zero Sign-Up Fees, Zero Platform Tax
items.description: Starting out is hard enough without having to pay upfront listing fees or subscriptions. TASA is 100% free for students to join, showcase skills, publish starter gigs, and begin meeting clients.

items.heading: Guaranteed Payments for Every Milestone
items.description: You've probably heard horror stories of students delivering work only for the client to disappear. On TASA, clients fund project milestones upfront into escrow before you type a word or draft a pixel. When you deliver, your payment is protected.

items.heading: Graduate with Proven Proof of Work
items.description: Break out of the 'entry-level requires 3 years experience' paradox. Build a track record of five-star reviews, completed client projects, and verified deliverables that give you a huge advantage when entering the job market.

items.heading: Instant Withdrawals in Your Local Currency
items.description: No jumping through complicated international payment hoops or losing value on exchange fees. Withdraw completed milestone funds straight to your local African bank account or mobile money wallet (M-Pesa, MTN MoMo, Airtel, and more).

items.heading: Build Professional Confidence Early
items.description: Working with real clients teaches you contract clarity, scope management, and professional communication long before your peers. Graduate not just with book knowledge, but with commercial confidence.

items.heading: Get Discovered Beyond Campus Walls
items.description: Your talent doesn't have to stay confined to your hostel or campus network. Connect with startups, growing businesses, and founders across Africa looking for hungry, creative talent.

items.heading: Clear Project Briefs from Day One
items.description: Know exactly what the client expects before you begin. Structured deliverables, deadlines, and revision terms eliminate misunderstandings and prevent endless free revisions.

items.heading: Turn Side Gigs into Long-Term Opportunities
items.description: A great logo, article, or frontend component can turn into a recurring monthly retainer, a summer internship, or even a full-time job offer before your final semester.
